_: C組 #2 — package target/location → quest alias. A radiant quest fills aliases (a VIP actor + a dungeon location); its performance packages then ACT on those aliases: travel to the dungeon the alias picked, escort the VIP there. Syntax: 'alias:<name>' (the ref/actor the alias holds → PackageTargetAlias / LocationFallback AliasForReference) or 'aliasLoc:<name>' (the location a location-alias holds → LocationFallback AliasForLocation). ownerQuest MUST be in-spec so alias indices resolve. ⚠ Mutagen field shape is reflection-verified, but whether AliasForReference vs AliasForLocation / PackageTargetAlias byte-matches a real radiant package needs a main-machine xEdit compare (see WAIT_USER). LocType FormID is a placeholder.

aliases.name: VIP
aliases._: alias index 0 — the actor to escort (forced to a real NPC in a real mod).

aliases.name: Safehouse
aliases._: alias index 1 — a Dungeon-type location picked at runtime (placeholder LocType).

packages._: Travel to the LOCATION the Safehouse alias holds (aliasLoc: → AliasForLocation).
Escort the VIP actor (alias: target) to the Safehouse location (aliasLoc: destination).
